Advances: specled.spec_review

Follow-up from specled_-gai (epic specled_-233, 2026-07-26). Ruled base-parity advisory by cold audit pass 2 and confirmed by verify passes 2 and 3; deliberately NOT actioned in that ticket because hardening it requires logic changes to lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex and test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs, which specled_-gai's Allowed touches restricted to covers-comment repointing.

THE GAP. specled.spec_review.coverage_no_debug_info_distinct_note requires that no_debug_info MFAs 'are not counted or reported as covered or uncovered'. Its covering test (test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:1391) asserts only that the rendered page SAYS SO — it does not assert the count.

Demonstrated during verification: patching lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex so that

    executed_count = length(covered) + length(no_debug)

makes the renderer report the no-debug MFA as executed in the closure line WHILE STILL printing 'not counted as covered or uncovered', and mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs stays green at 97 tests / 0 failures. So the requirement's central numeric claim has no failure mode; only its disclaimer text does.

WHY THIS IS NOT A specled_-gai DEFECT. At base 402f4a27 the identical clause lived inside the compound specled.spec_review.coverage_tab_bind_closure statement and carried exactly the same evidence — the same test, asserting the same rendered text. specled_-gai relocated the clause into its own requirement id with its own executed verification entry, which is strictly an improvement; it neither introduced nor weakened the gap. Taking ownership of an id does not oblige test-hardening outside a ticket's Allowed touches.

FIX. Add a numeric assertion to the covering test so the count itself is load-bearing — e.g. assert the closure line reports the no-debug MFA as NEITHER covered nor uncovered (assert the expected 'K executed' value, or refute the inflated one). Then verify the fix by falsification: apply the executed_count mutation above and confirm the test goes RED before committing.

WORTH CHECKING WHILE THERE. The same shape may affect the sibling clause in specled.spec_review.coverage_unresolvable_source_renders_distinct_note — confirm whether its 'unqualified'/'not counted' behavior is asserted numerically or only as rendered text.

The specled.spec_review spec-meta (.spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md:16-40) declares NO `realized_by` block (`awk '/^```spec-meta/,/^```$/' | grep realized_by` exits 1), and .spec/realization_hashes.json contains no "Html" or "review/html" entries. SHARED REQUIREMENT IDS: this ticket is the only one in the set touching specled.spec_review.coverage_no_debug_info_distinct_note / coverage_unresolvable_source_renders_distinct_note. Grepping all 21 sibling tickets for "html" / "spec_review" surfaced only specled_-vbo (Advances: specled.spec_review; it adds a command-tier verification for specled.spec_review.gh_pages_privilege_separation and will edit the `spec-verification` block of .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md plus priv/spec_init/workflows/spec_review.yml.eex). No other ticket edits test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs. ORDERING: no dependency on any other ticket; can land in any order within the single PR. GATE COST / FLAKE: test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs is an `execute: true` command target (spec_review.spec.md:849-851), so bare `mix spec.check` re-runs it. Verification of this change is cheap and local (`mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs`, ~97 tests); the mutation-then-revert step in item C is mandatory and must not leak into the commit — an implementer who skips it reproduces the exact defect the ticket is about (an assertion that cannot fail). FIXTURE COUPLING: the shared `req_reach/1` helper at test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:1154-1167 defaults `closure_mfa_count: 4, closure_coverage_pct: 75.0, covered_mfas: [3 items], uncovered_mfas: ["Mod.d/1"]`. Do NOT change those defaults to fix these two tests — other tests pin them literally (e.g. :1188 `assert html =~ "Closure: 4 MFAs — 3 executed (75.0%)."`, :1192). Override per-test only.

SCOPE CONTRACT (orchestrator, specled_-k6s — 2026-07-27)

Authoritative for mechanical scope checks. Supplements, does not replace, the
ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment's mandate (items A-D), which is what you implement.

## Allowed touches
- `test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs` — and nothing else. This is a ONE-FILE diff.

## Out of Scope (files)
- `.spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md` — item D is explicit: the requirement text is
  already correct and the covering verification entry already routes to these
  tests. Do NOT edit it.
- `lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex` — you will TEMPORARILY mutate line ~3025 to
  prove the assertions red, then REVERT. The committed diff must not contain it.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (orchestrator consolidates once at the end), `VERSION`,
  `.spec/realization_hashes.json`, `.spec/state.json`.
- Every file not listed under Allowed touches.

## Out of Scope (intent)
- Do NOT change the shared `req_reach/1` helper defaults
  (`closure_mfa_count: 4, closure_coverage_pct: 75.0, ...` at ~:1154-1167).
  Other tests pin those literally. Override per-test only.
- Leave the evidence-style asymmetry alone: the no-debug test uses a
  `# covers:` comment and its sibling uses `@tag spec:`. That is specled_-gai's
  settled shape, not yours to normalize.
- No new dependencies, no lib/ change, no refactor of adjacent tests.

## FALSIFIABILITY BAR — this ticket is one of the five the epic gates on
"Tests pass" is NOT evidence here. The whole point of this ticket is that the
existing assertion cannot fail. You must:
1. Temporarily patch `lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex` (~:3025) to
   `executed_count = length(covered) + length(Map.get(reach, :no_debug_info_mfas, [])) + length(Map.get(reach, :unresolvable_source_mfas, []))`
2. Run `mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs` and CONFIRM BOTH new
   closure assertions go RED. Paste the failure output into your completion record.
3. Revert `html.ex` to `executed_count = length(covered)` and confirm green.
4. Record the mutation, the red output, and the revert in the COMMIT MESSAGE.

An implementation that skips this is bounced on sight. `git diff --name-only`
must list exactly one file.

## Verification (change-scoped, run-until-green; host mix, no compose)
1. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
2. `mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs`
3. `mix format --check-formatted`
4. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands`
5. `git diff --name-only` must be exactly `test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs`.

Do NOT run bare `mix spec.check` and do NOT run the full suite. The orchestrator
owns whole-system proof at the merge gate and PR CI.

The diff (`git diff 2023373d..HEAD`) is +13 lines, test file only, all inside the two test bodies. The pinned aggregate assertion at :1188 ("Closure: 4 MFAs — 3 executed (75.0%).") still passes, so no silent default drift. - (b) Assertion is discriminating — proven by live mutation kill, not by inspection. While reviewing, lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex:3025 was carrying an uncommitted mutation folding the two lists into the count (`length(covered) + length(no_debug_info_mfas) + length(unresolvable_source_mfas)`). Under that mutation `mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs` = 97 tests, 2 failures, and the ONLY two failures were the new assertions at :1421 and :1459 (rendered "1 MFA — 1 executed", expected "0 executed"). Against clean HEAD lib (verified in a scratch copy, worktree untouched): 97 tests, 0 failures. Before this ticket neither test constrained executed_count at all, so that mutation would have shipped green. - (b, scope caveat, non-blocking) In `render_closure_reach/3` only executed_count is computed (`length(covered)`); mfa_count and pct are rendered verbatim from the reach map. So of the pinned line "1 MFA — 0 executed (0.0%)", the "1 MFA" and "(0.0%)" tokens are fixture passthrough and assert nothing about renderer logic. The load-bearing token is "0 executed" — which is exactly the discriminating number this ticket exists to pin. The exact-substring form (including the trailing period) is correct; a looser `=~ "0 executed"` would still be adequate but the exact form also catches plural/format regressions. - (c) Both refutes are discriminating, cross-verified by their sibling test in the same file. `refute "Source identity unavailable"` (:1425) is guarded by `assert "Source identity unavailable"` (:1460) under unresolvable_source_mfas; `refute "No debug info"` (:1464) is guarded by `assert "No debug info"` (:1422) under no_debug_info_mfas. Both strings are produced by distinct renderers (html.ex:3087 and html.ex:3095), each gated on a non-empty list. Neither refute can pass vacuously. The two note bodies use different verbs ("not counted as covered or uncovered" vs "not reported as covered or uncovered"), so the positive assertions do not cross-match either. - (d) Fixture shape matches the real producer exactly. test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs:495-503 (no_debug) and :519-524 (unresolvable) both assert the real CoverageClosure.build_v2 output for a single such MFA is covered_mfas == [], uncovered_mfas == [], closure_mfa_count == 1, closure_coverage_pct == 0.0. The new overrides reproduce that tuple exactly. This is also a fixture-honesty fix: the no_debug test previously inherited uncovered_mfas: ["Mod.d/1"] and closure_mfa_count: 4 with 0 covered but pct 75.0 — an arithmetically impossible reach map the real producer would never emit. - (e) No hygiene issues. Module is `use ExUnit.Case, async: true`; no Process.sleep, no spawned/unmanaged processes, no tmp-dir or filesystem use anywhere in html_test.exs. Both tests are pure iodata rendering. - Non-blocking observation, pre-existing (present at 2023373d, not introduced here): the no_debug test at :1390 marks its subject with a `# covers:` comment while its sibling at :1428 uses `@tag spec:`. In a test file the `@tag spec:` form is what feeds tagged-test evidence; the `# covers:` comment does not. Worth a separate ticket if tagged_tests attribution for specled.spec_review.coverage_no_debug_info_distinct_note is expected.

AUDIT: APPROVE Session: b19669f0-1a1a-42a6-b6f8-39da90177a9c Log: /Users/mz/.claude-personal/projects/-Users-mz-src-specled-ex/b19669f0-1a1a-42a6-b6f8-39da90177a9c.jsonl Reasoning: I enumerated `specled.spec_review`'s requirements myself from the `spec-requirements` block (.spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md:44-483) — 40 requirements, 38 `priority: must`, 2 `should` (coverage_pivot_touched_first, gh_pages_distribution) — so the verifier's denominator is exact. I then checked the out-of-radius group claim rather than accepting it, and it holds on a mechanical argument, not on "looks unrelated": the diff's only two mutation points are per-call keyword overrides at two `req_reach/1` call sites (the helper builds a fresh map via `Map.merge` on a literal each call, and the helper body at :1154-1167 is outside both diff hunks, which start at :1396 and :1428), so no other test's inputs move; with no lib/ change the renderer is byte-identical for every other test; and the module is `use ExUnit.Case, async: true` with zero `Process.sleep` / `File.write` / tmp-dir usage (grep count 0) rendering pure iodata from local maps, so there is no shared-state route either. That leaves exactly one cross-requirement coupling vector — a `refute` firing on text owned by another requirement — and it is closed below. No bounce warranted. == THE GROUP CLAIM: CHECKED, HOLDS == Bookkeeping correction (immaterial to the verdict): the verifier enumerated SEVEN requirement ids, not six — coverage_no_debug_info_distinct_note, coverage_unresolvable_source_renders_distinct_note, coverage_closure_line_format, coverage_tab_bind_closure, coverage_missing_attribution_unqualified, coverage_exact_up_to_escaped_processes_qualifier, coverage_line_mfa_intersection_qualifier (the last two share one bullet). So the unenumerated remainder is 31, not 32. I checked all 31. The orchestrator named two plausible coupling routes. Both are closed: (1) SHARED `render_closure_reach/3` PATH. Six further `must` requirements ride this path or the same tab and were NOT in the verifier's list: coverage_reached_by_tests_per_test_only (#24), coverage_rollup_badge (#27), coverage_generated_at_staleness (#28), coverage_degraded_banners_distinct (#29), coverage_no_tracer_manifest_banner (#30), coverage_tab_v2_envelope_data_layer (#31). #24 and #31 are literally rendered by the last element of `render_closure_reach/3`'s return list (`render_reached_by_tests_row/3`, lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex:3044). None is reached, because the diff adds no constraint that can observe them: the two added asserts pin only the `

` first line, and the two refutes name strings produced nowhere near that row. Sharing a render path is not sufficient for reach — the diff has to constrain the shared output, and it does not. (2) `req_reach/1` DEFAULT CONSUMERS. The helper is unchanged, verified structurally (hunk headers, not just the critic's word). Its literal pin at html_test.exs:1188 ("Closure: 4 MFAs — 3 executed (75.0%).") and :1192 are the covering evidence for coverage_closure_line_format (#23) and are untouched. The new asserts happen to reuse #23's exact format string, which redundantly re-pins the format in two more places — harmless, arguably a strengthening, and it cannot change #23's verdict. (3) FALSE-COUPLING VECTOR — the only real one, and it is closed by grep. Each refuted string has EXACTLY ONE production site in the entire lib/: "No debug info" at html.ex:3087 (`render_no_debug_info_note/1`) and "Source identity unavailable" at html.ex:3095 (`render_unresolvable_source_note/1`). Both renderers have an `([]) -> ""` head and only emit on a non-empty list, and both lists are owned by requirements #32/#33 themselves. So neither refute can be tripped by any of the other 31 requirements' output. Note also that `html` here is `Html.render_coverage_tab(...)` — a single subject's tab fragment, not the whole page — which bounds the refutes further. VERDICT ON THE GROUP CLAIM: none of the 31 unenumerated `must` requirements is implicated. The verifier's candor was warranted and its conclusion is correct. == INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATIONS (read/trace only; nothing re-run) == - lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex NOT in the committed diff. `git diff 2023373d..HEAD --stat` = one file, `test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs | 13 +++++++++++++`, 13 insertions / 0 deletions. The temporary mutation was reverted and did not leak. - .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md NOT in the diff. Item D honored. - req_reach/1 defaults UNCHANGED (:1154-1167 — closure_mfa_count: 4, closure_coverage_pct: 75.0, 3 covered, uncovered ["Mod.d/1"]). Both diff hunks are at :1396 and :1428, well past the helper. The literal pins at :1188/:1192 that would have caught default drift are intact. - REFUTES ARE DISCRIMINATING, judged from renderer source as instructed. Each refuted string has a single production site gated on its own non-empty list (html.ex:3086-3088, :3094-3096), and each is positively asserted present by the sibling test under the sibling condition (:1422 asserts "No debug info"; :1460 asserts "Source identity unavailable"). A string that is asserted present in one test and refuted in its mirror cannot be one that never renders. Non-vacuous. - FIXTURE VALUES MIRROR THE REAL PRODUCER — citation checked, not accepted. The verifier cited coverage_closure_test.exs:519-524; that block reads `unresolvable_source_mfas == [@fixture_a_mfa]`, `no_debug_info_mfas == []`, `covered_mfas == []`, `uncovered_mfas == []`, `closure_mfa_count == 1`, `closure_coverage_pct == 0.0`. The mirrored no_debug case sits just above at :495-502 with the same tuple. The new overrides (closure_mfa_count: 1, closure_coverage_pct: 0.0, covered/uncovered both []) reproduce real `CoverageClosure.build_v2/2` output exactly. Citation is accurate. - CENTRAL TICKET CLAIM VERIFIED AT BASE, independently. `git show 2023373d:...html_test.exs` for both tests shows assertions ONLY on rendered prose ("No debug info", "Ghost.Mod.fun/1", "not counted as covered or uncovered" / "Source identity unavailable", "retained in the closure denominator") — zero numeric constraint and zero cross-label refute. So the requirement's numeric clause genuinely had no failure mode before this diff, and all four added assertions are net-new coverage rather than restatement. - SEAM DISCLOSURES ARE HONEST, not downgraded contradictions. `render_closure_reach/3` destructures only `covered_mfas` and computes `executed_count = length(covered)` (html.ex:3020-3025); `mfa_count` and `pct` are interpolated verbatim (:3040). So of "1 MFA — 0 executed (0.0%)." only "0 executed" is renderer-computed — exactly as both the verifier and the test-critic disclosed. I confirmed the sharper half of that seam myself: `uncovered_mfas` has ZERO references anywhere in lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex (grep, no hits), so the requirement's "never merged into the covered/uncovered lists" clause has no renderer observable other than the count. Pinning the count is therefore the strongest assertion available at this seam, not a substitute for a stronger one that was skipped. List membership stays pinned producer-side at coverage_closure_test.exs:498-499. - NO OVER-PINNING OF ADJACENT REQUIREMENTS. The template is `...#{executed_count} executed (#{format_closure_pct(pct)}).#{render_attribution_qualifier(mode, subject_reach)}` — the asserted substring terminates at the period, immediately BEFORE the qualifier span. Both fixtures carry `attribution: :exact` (unchanged context lines, not introduced by this diff), so the "(exact within chained windows)" span does render but is not pinned. Requirements #25/#26 are not coupled to the new asserts. - NO INTEGRATION_REGRESSION_LATENT. Nothing here is seam-covered-but-disconnected: the fixture is a faithful reproduction of `build_v2/2` output (verified above), and the production call path `Review.build_view/3` -> `build_v2/2` -> Coverage pivot is the one the requirement names. - Fixture-honesty side effect worth recording: the no_debug test previously inherited `uncovered_mfas: ["Mod.d/1"]` with `closure_mfa_count: 4` and 75.0% while covered was [] — a reach map the real producer cannot emit. The diff replaces it with a producer-faithful one. - Guard-branch check: `render_closure_reach(%{closure_mfa_count: 0}, ...)` (html.ex:3010) short- circuits to "0 MFAs." — had the fixture used 0 the new assert would have been on a different branch and vacuous. It uses 1, so the assert lands on the real code path. == NON-BLOCKING, NOT NEW == The `# covers:` vs `@tag spec:` evidence asymmetry (:1390 vs :1428) is pre-existing at 2023373d and explicitly out of scope per item D / the SCOPE CONTRACT.
